articles.title: Cloudflare Introduces Context-Aware Vulnerability Remediation
articles.description: Cloudflare launches an early-access service using OpenAI Daybreak models and WAF network telemetry to find, prioritize, and patch code vulnerabilities.
articles.summary: Cloudflare connects live edge traffic insights with OpenAI Daybreak models to uncover vulnerabilities and propose verified patches.

articles.title: Chrome 152 for Android Adds Desktop Security Fixes
articles.description: Google has launched Chrome 152 for Android, delivering stability updates and matching the security fixes provided to desktop platforms.
articles.summary: Google has announced the rollout of Chrome 152 for Android, aligning mobile security protections with desktop releases alongside overall stability improvements.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot Model Access Ties to Billing Org for Team Plans
articles.description: GitHub updated Copilot model access rules for users with multiple organizations on Team plans, tying permissions directly to the paying organization.
articles.summary: GitHub has adjusted its policy enforcement so that an individual's Copilot model access is governed strictly by the organization responsible for billing.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot in VS Code Receives August 2026 Agent Updates
articles.description: Explore new features in VS Code v1.132 through v1.135, including agent session tools, chat search, integrated browser tweaks, and dictation updates.
articles.summary: The August 2026 releases of Visual Studio Code bring major improvements to Copilot agent management, transcript navigation, browser integration, and localized dictation.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot Global Model Policy Enforces Default States
articles.description: GitHub is rolling out enforcement for Copilot global model policies across enterprise plans, updating unconfigured model states automatically.
articles.summary: GitHub has officially launched the general availability of its global model policy, standardizing how enterprise plans inherit Copilot model access.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio August 2026 Update Details
articles.description: Learn about the August 2026 update for GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio, including organizational agents, reasoning effort controls, and Git code reviews.
articles.summary: The August 2026 update for GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio introduces enhanced model management, reasoning controls, organization-wide custom agents, and automated Git reviews.

articles.title: Google Releases Chrome 152 for Android
articles.description: Google has announced Chrome 152 for Android, rolling out performance fixes and matching desktop security patches via Google Play.
articles.summary: Google has begun rolling out Chrome 152 for Android, delivering stability updates and matching desktop security fixes to mobile devices.

articles.title: Google Releases Chrome 152 with 327 Security Fixes
articles.description: Chrome 152 brings 327 security patches to Windows, Mac, and Linux, addressing critical use-after-free and memory issues across core browser engines.
articles.summary: Google has promoted Chrome 152 to the stable desktop channel, rolling out hundreds of security patches across supported operating systems.
